method: Read all190 response, identity, admission, provenance, time, proposal-mode and evidence-chain propositions, all28 complete context profiles and four exact governor sets against complete bounded source sections and all transitive contexts. Every full original payload and all903 ordered bindings are verified against immutable evidence and exact bytes. Distinguish the unchanged general date representation and two acceptance-mode definitions from the new fallback DATE domain, current response validation and expanded operation domain. Three independent corrections preserve exact individual predicates and occurrences. Durable archive custody is verified losslessly; no implementation, tests or proof results were consulted.

decisions.PRESERVED_ENVELOPE_SHAPE: The exact original top-level field inventory, one UTF8 JSON file, nested promptIdentity shape, no duplicate top-level identity and historical-only duplicate migration condition remain. humanInputRequests already existed in that envelope; A changes its closed value contract, not the member list. Current response conformance is separate.
decisions.PRESERVED_IDENTITY_ALGORITHM: Exact prompt-body SHA256, application allocation, and no own/response/circular digest dependencies remain. Current response-contract/context preimages change separately. No new algorithm, self-hash or invented response field is introduced.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESPONSE_EVENTS: The four mutually exclusive response types remain. Clarification/blockers/execution failures stay controlled response events rather than accepted canonical data changes. A/F1/F2 does not create a fifth type or promote a blocked event.
decisions.EXACT_RESPONSE_IDENTITY_REJECTION_GOVERN: All four exact captions retain their bounded original governed ID/range sets, actor and before-canonical-mutation force. Adjacent standalone scan text is not absorbed into the rejection list; new clauses remain separate occurrences.
decisions.PRESERVED_RECORD_IDENTITY: The exclusive response-local tempKey or reserved targetId choice and exact target existence/project/stage/operation/scope/update/agent-writable guards remain. B/E reference resolution does not authorize authored canonical IDs or turn a referenced record into a writer target.
decisions.PRESERVED_SYNTAX_TRANSPORT_AND_GENERIC_G: Each exact JSON syntax/root/size/member/quote, unchanged version/context category, attachment identity/byte, retry/collision/transition and fixed primitive-name guard remains. The duplicate-member scan remains an ambiguity scan, not a second semantic parser. Concrete current schema/arguments/provenance and relationship domains are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_AUTHORITY_REJECTION: External actors still cannot override application independence, evidence sufficiency or release, or fabricate native results. Native observations stay application-owned. F2 echoes cannot supply these results or hidden independence.
decisions.PRESERVED_PRECONDITION_BINDING_AND_RETRY: Every original proposal revision/prompt/contract/context/scope/version/record/runtime binding requirement remains, with exact retry returning existing identities/receipts and no duplicate state. Actual current recomputation is separately changed; binding fields do not establish semantic admissibility by themselves.
decisions.PRESERVED_EXTRACTION_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA: Every exact raw response/hash/real-array-index pointer/prompt/value/tempkey/collection/record/evidence/revision/sequence/time provenance field remains. Application allocations cannot be falsely attributed to nonexistent response fields. Actual current normalizer/relationship/validation meanings are separately changed; original bytes and pointers stay intact.
decisions.PRESERVED_TIME_BOUNDARIES: RFC3339 instant form, uppercaseZ/milliseconds, no leap seconds, boundary-only offset normalization with original evidence, no date-to-instant coercion, monotonic event ordering and device-time epistemic limits remain. Registered external timestamp authority is required where specified; missing support remains UNKNOWN, unverified claims SOURCE_ASSERTED. No F2 echo creates trusted time.
decisions.PRESERVED_MODE_AUTHORITY: Default and mandatory human acceptance, exact Stage01/co-confirmation/replacement protections, agent-only reserved auto-commit eligibility, no agent change of closed/versioned mode, and application-command direct commit remain. F1/F2 does not authorize auto-commit of human decisions or external ingestion of native results.
decisions.PRESERVED_HUMAN_CONFIRMATION: External conversational answers remain proposed humanAuthorityCandidates until actual direct confirmation/correction. Preserve exact comparison, no reconfirmation/retyping, dedicated human command, input-version and replacement-prompt consequences. A structured fallback is a separate route; accepted current dependent co-proposals are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_EVIDENCE_CHAIN: The exact ordered requirement→test definition→route/package→execution→observation→evidence→normalization→gate chain remains. TEST_TYPE describes verification semantics, never executor responsibility. Echoes and route labels cannot skip observation or evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_RESPONSE_CONFORMANCE: Actual response/3 conformance consumes applicable A closed requests, B nested proof relationships, C/C1 current source accounting, D native definition semantics, E exact variance normalization and F1/F2 operation/input contracts. Original top-level shape and file transport remain; no second ingestion path or inherited old success is accepted.
decisions.CURRENT_REGISTERED_SCOPE: Current stage/operation/scope declarations and wrong-scope rejection include exactly F1 conditional pairs and their current reserved subject/test/fixture/target/history bindings, with applicable F2 input minimum. Preserve matrix currentness/reservation and receipt-only authority; no label grants executor or writer changes.
decisions.CURRENT_CONTRACT_AND_CONTEXT_IDENTITY: Actual current contract/context preimages, wrong-prompt/contract/context and stale-proposal rejection, and acceptance recomputation consume applicable A–F2 current semantic dependency closure. Hash algorithms and precondition mechanics remain. Matching old digests cannot grandfather changed contracts or missing current inputs.
decisions.CURRENT_CLOSED_FIELDS_AND_VALUE_DOMAINS: Concrete unknown-property, producer/type/enum/null/empty admission domains include A exact request/control rules, B application-installed references, D closed definitions and E embedded/direct variance forms. Preserve nonoperative extra embedded canonicalJSON context under E while direct family fields remain closed. An affectedRecords reference grants no ownership.
decisions.CURRENT_RELATIONSHIP_VALIDATION: Actual resolution/duplicates/cardinality/cross-project rejection and canonical field/target mapping include B nested proofExpression reference and E TEST_ID. Resolve only same-response tempKeys or operation-supplied current recordIDs uniquely through application ingestion. Same-test identical variance forms merge into one current contract with both provenances; conflicts/ambiguity block.
decisions.CURRENT_PROVENANCE_VALIDATION: Actual source-derived provenance includes C/C1 original/member/occurrence trace, E exact authored-source/test-bound normalization and F1 execution identity/history/isolation/raw-native provenance with F2 input support/custody. Echoes do not prove execution, independence or stronger attestation; unavailable content is not fabricated.
decisions.CURRENT_VARIANCE_DUPLICATE_CONTENT: Duplicate canonical-content rejection now distinguishes E identical embedded/direct same-test authoring, which produces one enclosing current contract with both provenances, from conflicting/ambiguous duplicates, which block. Preserve the whole normalized object including nonoperative embedded context; no favorable winner or competing contract is chosen.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_DEFINITION_VALIDITY: Current native identity, argument, construct and binding admission consumes D exact parser/selector/numeric/collection/assertion/error semantics and F1 compatible reviewed execution binding where applicable. No added primitive, coercion or implicit binding is authorized. Definition rejection, prestart BLOCKED, data UNDETERMINED and runtime EXECUTION_FAILED remain distinct.
decisions.CURRENT_NORMALIZATION_AND_VALIDATION_MAP: Actual normalization/value/validation-rule/result mapping consumes applicable A–F2 admitted value and relationship semantics. Preserve every original raw value, real pointer and preimage. An application-created relationship/ID is never falsely attributed to authored canonical identity; current hashes alone prove no semantic approval.
decisions.CURRENT_FALLBACK_DATE_DOMAIN: A defines valid fallback DATE values, but the general base date-only YYYY-MM-DD format atom itself is unchanged and is independently corrected as retained. No broader timestamp restriction or new generic date representation is inferred.
decisions.CURRENT_PROPOSAL_MODE_DOMAIN_AND_VALIDAT: The exactly-one acceptance-mode declaration extends to F1 conditional DATA_PROPOSAL operation domain. The two acceptance-mode definitions themselves are independently retained as unchanged review policy; actual current response validation is governed by separate changed conformance/admission duties.
decisions.CURRENT_EXTERNAL_HUMAN_COACCEPTANCE: Exact confirmed external human values may be co-accepted under the existing separate authority transaction, while the dependent current external proposal satisfies A response structure and F2 applicable input basis. Confirmation or echoes waive no validity, review or stronger evidence. This does not reclassify external humanAuthorityCandidates as typed fallback answers.
decisions.CORRECTION_3268: Base1505 requires the general date-only representation YYYY-MM-DD. A successor1650 uses that same format and adds valid-Gregorian/four-digit-year rules specifically for fallback DATE answers. It neither changes this general format predicate nor supplies a new date representation. Retain the exact source occurrence and general representation duty; the new fallback validity obligation remains separately governed by A.
decisions.CORRECTION_1849: Base1514 defines HUMAN_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED as committing a validated pending proposal only after explicit operator acceptance through the named commands. This is the review-policy/ordering definition, not the actual current validation predicate. A–F2 does not remove, alter or bypass that permission boundary. Retain the exact mode definition and original contexts; current response conformance and expanded operation-mode domain remain separately changed.
decisions.CORRECTION_1850: Base1515 defines VALIDATED_AUTO_COMMIT as committing a validated proposal without operator review, subject to the unchanged eligibility and human-authority exclusions at1517. A–F2 changes applicable validation inputs, not this mode meaning or its permission boundaries. Retain the exact definition; actual current validation and expanded operation-mode domain remain separately changed.
